Package com.privatechain.core.builder

Class BlockchainConfig

java.lang.Object
com.privatechain.core.builder.BlockchainConfig
public final class BlockchainConfig extends Object
Fluent builder and single assembly point for all blockchain subsystems.

BlockchainConfig is the only place where modules are composed (design.md §1 — Explicit Wiring). No global state, no service-locator, no classpath scanning. Every dependency is provided explicitly via the builder (FR-CFG-01).

Minimum viable setup (FR-CFG-02)


 BlockchainNode node = BlockchainConfig.builder().build();
 node.start();

Milestone 8 additions (T-066)

Two new builder parameters control the mempool lifecycle wired into BlockchainNode:

  • BlockchainConfig.Builder.mempoolTtl(Duration) — TTL for unconfirmed transactions (default: 30 minutes)
  • BlockchainConfig.Builder.maxMempoolSize(int) — max pool capacity (default: unbounded)
Since:
1.0.0
